name: micro-latest
description: Latest development version of the modern terminal text editor with cutting-edge features

tools.description: Latest development build of micro text editor with newest features and improvements
tools.usage:
micro file.txt # Edit file with latest features
micro -colorscheme dracula # Use modern color scheme
micro -plugin install lsp # Install language server plugin
micro +50:20 file.txt # Jump to line 50, column 20
micro -option autosu=true # Enable auto-save on focus loss
